sampling.method: Stratified random selection without replacement from publicly listed Instagram profiles, with fixed country quotas and 10 accounts per region.
sampling.frame: Modash public country directories; only profiles with an explicit matching creator location are eligible. This is a directory-based sample, not a uniform sample of all Instagram accounts.
sampling.location_basis: Modash profile.location field, not audience geography or inferred ethnicity.
sampling.image_basis: Profile pictures served by Modash image proxy, downloaded at collection time; direct live Instagram verification was unavailable.
sampling.image_processing: JPEG, maximum 96 pixels on the longest side, quality 60.
